materials.material: Century Ply Club Prime boiling water proof (BWP) plywood. Each veneer is treated before pressing, and its Glue Line Protection makes it borer and termite proof
Century Ply WIN MR plywood, made from imported seasoned hardwood and bonded under computer-controlled heat and pressure, equivalent to BWR grade plywood of other brands
Imported high-density HDF of superior quality, with a lifetime warranty
Soft-close telescopic channels from Häfele, and Tandem box drawers from Blum, Häfele or Grass
Premium series sliding systems from Aristo, with award-winning designs
A wide range of premium finishes like PU lacquer, PU matt, lacquer glass, glass acrylics and veneer

items.term: As per the brand's own warranty

warranty.covers: It covers defects in materials and workmanship from the date of installation, with normal use. If there is a defect, The KariGhars repairs or replaces the item.
warranty.notCovered: Misuse, scratches or mishandling, normal wear and tear like laminate chipping or fading of fabrics, consumables like light bulbs, third-party purchases, and changes, relocation or reinstallation done by anyone other than The KariGhars team.
